pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, gentle and hopeful atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
In a heart that kept falling apart
a small breath finds its way
the scattered pieces in the air
I gather again with my hands

Even the dried-up tears
descend like morning dew
the cold, faded scars
I’ll quietly embrace

[Chorus]
A faint light flickers nearby
shining beside my shadow
it stirs me as I breathe
reminding me this is not the end

[Verse 2]
The loneliness brushed by the wind
remains as a memory
the deeply buried sadness
slowly settles within

I call my own name again
once blocked, once breathless
I hold a little courage
to lift the broken me

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo)

[Bridge]
In a colorless world I embrace myself
soft light blooms around
covering me with gentle breaths
shaping the me of today

[Chorus]
Even when the night grows long
delicate waves beat at my chest
those currents soothe me too
flowing into a new day

[Outro]
After the broken days I’ve crossed
light finally finds me
telling me not to cry, that I’m alright
quietly holding me
I am reborn
